pr.title: Plan answering an agent's questions in Projector's band
pr.head: a13ba48c7aeed1ad5f76ba8787c5caa86c35fa68

summary: Projector's fix and review loops run subagents that sometimes need a decision only the person can make. Today a subagent hands its question to the main loop, which asks it as a line of text in the transcript. That line scrolls away, nothing lists which questions are still open, and nothing carries the answer back to the subagent.

This pull request adds one plan, docs/projects/questions-drawer/readme.md, at status: ready and priority: now. It changes no code. The plan builds on Projector's band: a Claude Code hooks module, merged in #267, that draws a strip above the prompt listing the pull requests the loops track. It uses the /projector command and the band-prefixed state keys that #269 gives the band, so its implementation follows #269.

1. An agent posts a numbered question. The module registers a tool, mcp__projector__ask, that takes a one-line question, a required recommendation, and optional detail, options, and pr. It numbers the question, #337.3 for the third about #337 or a bare 1 otherwise, stores it in the session's own plugin state, bandQuestions, and returns the number at once.
  2. The session's band lists it under its pull request. The number is a press target that opens a drawer: detail, then lettered choices (a., b.) with the recommended one marked, then a lettered Type something field and dismiss. Other sessions do not see it.
  3. The answer goes straight back, with context. The module sends the answer, as #337.3.a with the question and the choice, to the subagent if it is still live, or queues it for the main loop otherwise. A refused delivery reopens the question. A reference typed in the prompt adds its question and choice to the prompt's context.

Earlier heads stored questions in shared files that every session's band read. Later heads keep each question in the session that asked it, require a recommendation, and, from this head on, name every question and answer by a reference you can type.

cards.title: Terms
cards.html:
• Projector's band: the strip above the Claude Code prompt that #267 added and /projector shows or hides, one line per tracked pull request.
  • Drawer: the extra lines that open under a band line when you press it.
  • $.state: values Claude Code holds for one session on a plugin's behalf; they survive a hot reload of the module, and writing one redraws the band.
  • Main screen: Claude Code's non-fullscreen layout, used under tmux, where only a Button takes a press.
  • Reference: a question's number, #337.3 or 1, and an answer's number with its letter, #337.3.a.

cards.title: Readiness
cards.html: The plan owns every open question at ready. Section 6 lists three: opening a pull request's drawer on the main screen (owned, outside this plan's questions), whether a resumed session keeps $.state (deferred until observed), and Codex (deferred). None blocks implementation.

Changes requested: a bare-number reference matches ordinary numbers in a prompt, and a pull request's reference changes form with the band's repositories. The author holds the pull request for more changes.

groups.title: The questions-drawer plan
groups.kicker: How an agent's question reaches the person and how the answer gets back
intro: The plan covers the whole round trip: the ask tool and the question it records (sections 2.1 to 2.3), what the band draws (2.4), the files the implementation touches (2.5), the reasons for each choice (3), and the acceptance tests (4).
Read section 2.1 first. Its numbered steps are the design, and the later sections fill in each step's data and drawing.

checks.text: The API calls the plan names exist as described in Claude Code 2.1.296's plugin declarations: $.tool.register with isDeferred, $.ui.notify, $.session.send({ to: { agentId } }), $.agent.list() with its statuses, $.prompt.submit and its drop result, $.state, Button with plain, Input with onSubmit, and ctrl+x tab to focus the band.
project check passes at this head, and the plan's frontmatter reads status: ready and priority: now.

files.note: The new plan: the problem, the ask tool and the question it records, the band's drawing, the design reasons, and the acceptance tests.

checks.text: The plugin API documents { deny: reason } as how a tool.call hook refuses a call, and the model reads the reason as an error result.
The live statuses here, pending, running, waiting, and idle, and the ended ones, completed, failed, and killed, are exactly the AgentStatus values in the 2.1.296 plugin API.

A bare-number reference such as 2 also matches ordinary numbers in a prompt, so an unrelated prompt can carry question 2's context. A pull request's reference changes between #337.3 and projector#337.3 as the band's repositories change, and #337.3 can match two questions across repositories. Give every reference one fixed, distinctive form.
bandQuestions and bandQuestionCounts follow the band prefix that #269 gives the band's state at b90b297.
In the 2.1.296 API, a Button takes Text children, so the underlined suggestion-colored number is drawable. Input takes a placeholder, and Text takes strikethrough for a dismissed line.
With no hotkey, a digit typed into an empty prompt presses no letter, so the letters are only labels.
